must_find.notes: The entire 'Return or Destruction of Confidential Information' clause (template Section 8, clause_type return_destruction) is deleted. A whole-doc read cannot see an absence; only deep coverage catches it, which is why this case is mode=deep. Matched against coverage.absent_required (item_key + clause_type + note).

notes: A required clause is entirely removed and the sections renumbered so nothing looks out of place. GREEN is catastrophic (false_green_budget_eligible=true). risk_tier_allowed is red-only per the governance spec: a deleted mandatory clause is a red-tier omission, and if the engine returns anything softer the tier mapping is too lenient and that per-case fail is the signal.
